source: City of Roseburg, Water Treatment Facilities Preliminary Design Report (July 2009), Section 4, 'Summary of Hydraulic Capacity Evaluation', pp. 4-14 to 4-15 (PDF p.120-121). Withheld from the agent.
question: Expand Winchester WTP from 12 to 18 mgd: which units limit, and what modification?

items.engineers: Approach velocity through the slide gates exceeds regulatory limit above 16.5 mgd; relocate fish screens outside the gated openings.
leak_phrases: structure as currently configured is limited to 16.5

items.engineers: Firm capacity about 14-15 mgd (tests). Replace the 4 mgd Pump No. 1 with a 6 mgd pump with VFD -> firm 18 mgd.
Existing basin handles somewhat more than 12 mgd hydraulically, but a second parallel basin is needed to treat > 12 mgd (treatment limit).
leak_phrases: designed to be expanded with a parallel basin
provides for the addition of a second, parallel
second basin will need to be added

items.engineers: Each filter 4 mgd to clearwell, but filter-to-waste only ~2 mgd; two new filters and filter-to-waste piping modified for 4 mgd.
leak_phrases: provides for 4 mgd hydraulic capacity through the filter-to-waste

items.engineers: Adequate for flows up to 18 mgd (no change).
Nominal firm 10 mgd, true firm ~11.5 mgd (pumps run above rating). Add a 4 mgd and a 6 mgd (VFD) pump in the two open slots -> firm 18 mgd.
leak_phrases: true firm capacity is currently about 11.5

items.engineers: Must be replaced with a larger tank for pumped flows > 14 mgd.
leak_phrases: second hydropneumatic surge tank is likely not practical
